description.value: Chipotle Burnaby Metrotown is a fast-casual Mexican chain restaurant on Kingsway offering fully customizable burritos, bowls, quesadillas, tacos, and salads. The brand is built around its 'Food with Integrity' sourcing philosophy, using 53 real ingredients free of artificial colors, flavors, or preservatives. Cyclists passing through the Metrotown corridor will find a high-calorie, protein-rich meal stop with vegetarian and vegan options on an otherwise dense commercial strip.
